label: For "Provider Credentialing Document Intelligence": Ingest provider applications and supporting evidence, classify each document, extract fields with page-level provenance, validate completeness and reconcile values across sources so credentialing staff review a ready evidence packet instead of raw paperwork. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Splitting train and test by page and not by provider.
